---
title: "The Height Signal"
subtitle: "20,000 player-season observations in one view"
---

```{r}
#| label: fig-height-signal
#| fig-cap: "Each point is one simulated player-season observation. Height is measured in inches; performance is a composite of kills, blocks, digs, and aces, standardized within position."
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
#| out-width: 100%
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(ggplot2)

set.seed(2409)
n <- 20000
position <- sample(
  c("Middle blocker", "Outside hitter", "Setter", "Libero"),
  n,
  replace = TRUE,
  prob = c(.22, .34, .18, .26)
)
position_mean <- c("Middle blocker" = 74, "Outside hitter" = 72,
                   "Setter" = 71, "Libero" = 67)
position_effect <- c("Middle blocker" = .75, "Outside hitter" = .45,
                     "Setter" = .15, "Libero" = -.30)
height <- rnorm(n, position_mean[position], 2.4)
performance <- 50 + position_effect[position] * (height - 70) +
  rnorm(n, 0, 10)

players <- data.frame(
  height = height,
  performance = pmax(1, pmin(99, performance)),
  position = factor(position, levels = names(position_mean))
)

ggplot(players, aes(height, performance, colour = position)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .16, size = .7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE,
              linewidth = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~position, ncol = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#e76f51", "#087f8c", "#e9b949", "#6c63a8")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(58, 84, 4)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(58, 84), ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    x = "Player height (inches)",
    y = "Composite performance score"
  ) +
  guides(colour = "none") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#101b26", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#172635", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#385064", linewidth = .35),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f2c14e", colour = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(colour = "#101b26", face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "#d9e3ea"),
    axis.title = element_text(colour = "#f7fbfd", face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(colour = "#f7fbfd", face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(colour = "#5f7374")
  )
```

This graphic uses simulated observations to show the intended shape of the analysis. The real project should replace the simulation with collected player-level data before making claims about college volleyball.
